research_question: Do ToolSandbox, InjecAgent, and tau3 provide task-disjoint predictive signal for the frozen Semantic Markov / Structured Semantic State v3 hybrid method, and which sources are suitable for further large-scale world-model data collection?

frozen_adapter_dataset.failed_preflight_v1_reason: tau3 reused a tool name across distinct schemas; candidate identifiers were repaired to include the frozen schema hash before any model result was observed

split.assignment: Sort task fingerprints by SHA256(seed, source, task fingerprint), then allocate floor(0.6N), floor(0.2N), and the remainder.
split.injecagent_pair_rule: Both clean and poisoned rows for a group must remain in one split.

representations.frequency_prior: Training-only selected-action frequency with legal-candidate masking and Laplace smoothing.
representations.tfidf_candidate_logistic: Binary TF-IDF candidate scorer over causal visible state plus candidate schema; scores are normalized only across legal candidates.
representations.semantic_markov: Frozen Semantic Markov representation and HybridSemanticWorldModel action head.
representations.structured_markov_v3: Frozen Structured Semantic State v3 representation with a label-blind source adapter and the same hybrid action head.
representations.full_history_diagnostic: Frozen causal full-visible-history diagnostic with the same hybrid action head; one visible prefix per record.
forbidden_features: decision target inside the state representation
execution outcome inside the action representation
variant, attack family, security, utility, reward, or checker labels
row, group, task, source-index, or prompt identifiers as model features

targets.execution_error_probe: Train the existing candidate-conditional evidence-error head only for scopes that pass the frozen exact-outcome support gate.
targets.not_available: No source contains adjacent multi-step semantic states, so the full five-label evidence-transition head and free-running rollout are structural NO-GO diagnostics rather than trained endpoints.

full_world_model_readiness_gate.interpretation: A source can pass action-only suitability while remaining unsuitable for full world-model scaling.
